Total 217 unique URLs, all 31 days of 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 walked (2026-10-04 = 0, the site has no day sitemap for it, HTTP 404). ROUTE (works): robots.txt 200 and permissive for us (it blocks named AI crawlers only) advertises /sitemap/archive.xml, /sitemap/googlenews.xml, /sitemap/update/all.xml. /sitemap/archive.xml (200, 410 KB) is a flat urlset index with exactly ONE per-day file per calendar date since 1997: /sitemap/archive/all/YYYYMMDD_1.xml. 31 fetches of those files, each 200 and 0.4-2.5 KB, give the day's article URLs (/section/slug/articleNNNNNNNN.ece). KEY: <lastmod> in those files is the last-EDIT time (dateModified, drifts up to 5 days), NOT the publish date; the listed date is the file's own date, i.e. the site's archive day.
